theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 25 群

items.colloc: government spending 政府支出 | consumer spending 消費支出
items.distinct: expense 費用 | cost 成本
ex: The company reduced its travel spending this year.
公司今年減少了差旅支出。
Consumer spending has grown significantly during the season.
消費支出在本季顯著成長。
Budget cuts are necessary to control excessive spending.
為了控制過度支出，預算刪減是必要的。

items.pos: n. 標準；水準 | adj. 標準的
items.colloc: high standard 高標準 | meet the standard 符合標準
items.distinct: criterion 準則 | norm 規範
ex: Our products meet the highest quality standards.
我們的產品符合最高品質標準。
We must maintain a high standard of customer service.
我們必須維持高水準的客戶服務。
It is standard practice to review all contracts.
審閱所有合約是標準作業程序。

items.colloc: steady growth 穩定成長 | steady job 穩定的工作
items.distinct: stable 穩固的 | constant 持續的
ex: The company has seen a steady increase in sales.
公司經歷了穩定的銷售成長。
He is looking for a steady job in accounting.
他正在尋找一份穩定的會計工作。
Prices have remained steady throughout the past month.
價格在過去一個月內保持平穩。

items.colloc: in stock 有庫存 | out of stock 缺貨
items.distinct: inventory 存貨清單 | share 股份單位
ex: We currently have plenty of stock in the warehouse.
我們目前倉庫裡有充足的庫存。
The item is currently out of stock online.
該商品目前在網路上缺貨。
Investors watched the company stock price closely.
投資人密切關注該公司的股價。

items.colloc: highly successful 極為成功的 | successful career 成功的職涯
items.distinct: prosperous 繁榮的 | effective 有效的
ex: She had a very successful career in marketing.
她在行銷領域擁有非常成功的職涯。
The product launch was extremely successful last week.
上週的產品發表會非常成功。
Hard work is the key to a successful project.
勤奮工作是專案成功的關鍵。

items.colloc: totally different 完全不同 | totally agree 完全同意
items.distinct: completely 完全地 | entirely 全然地
ex: These two proposals are totally different in scope.
這兩份提案在範疇上完全不同。
I totally agree with your assessment of the market.
我完全同意你對市場的評估。
The office was totally renovated last summer.
辦公室在去年夏天進行了徹底翻修。

items.colloc: valid passport 有效護照 | valid reason 合理理由
items.distinct: legal 合法的 | effective 有效的（指功能）
ex: Please ensure your parking permit is still valid.
請確保您的停車證仍然有效。
He provided a valid reason for his absence.
他對缺席提供了合理的理由。
The contract remains valid for another two years.
這份合約在未來兩年內仍然有效。

items.colloc: company vehicle 公司車輛 | motor vehicle 機動車輛
items.distinct: transportation 運輸 | carriage 車廂
ex: Every company vehicle must undergo regular maintenance.
每一輛公司車輛都必須定期保養。
The delivery vehicle arrived earlier than expected.
配送車輛比預期更早抵達。
Safe driving is essential for all vehicle operators.
安全駕駛對所有車輛駕駛員來說至關重要。

items.pos: n. 浪費；廢棄物 | v. 浪費
items.colloc: waste time 浪費時間 | industrial waste 工業廢棄物
items.distinct: trash 垃圾 | loss 損失
ex: We should not waste time on minor details.
我們不該在細枝末節上浪費時間。
The new policy helps reduce industrial waste output.
新政策有助於減少工業廢棄物的產出。
It is a waste of resources to print everything.
把所有東西都印出來是一種資源浪費。

items.colloc: widely used 廣泛使用的 | widely known 廣為人知的
items.distinct: broadly 大體上 | extensively 廣泛地（程度更深）
ex: This software is widely used in the industry.
這套軟體在業界被廣泛使用。
The CEO is widely known for his vision.
執行長以其願景而廣為人知。
Opinions on the new strategy vary widely here.
大家對新策略的意見分歧很大。

items.colloc: ability to learn 學習能力 | proven ability 已證實的能力
items.distinct: capability 潛在能力 | talent 天賦
ex: The manager has a great ability to lead teams.
這位經理擁有卓越的團隊領導能力。
Employees should demonstrate the ability to work independently.
員工應展現獨立工作的能力。
Our team has the ability to meet tight deadlines.
我們的團隊有能力達成緊湊的期限。

items.colloc: accurate data 準確數據 | accurate report 精確報告
items.distinct: precise 精確的 | exact 精確的（無誤差）
ex: Please provide an accurate summary of the meeting.
請提供一份精確的會議摘要。
The accountant ensured all figures were accurate.
會計師確保所有數字都是準確的。
Getting accurate feedback is important for growth.
獲取準確的回饋對成長很重要。

items.pos: n. 前進；進展 | v. 前進 | adj. 事前的
items.colloc: in advance 事先 | make an advance 取得進展
items.distinct: progress 進步 | improvement 改進
ex: Please let us know your requirements in advance.
請事先告知我們您的需求。
The technology represents a major advance in medicine.
這項技術代表了醫學上的重大進展。
We made significant advances in the development stage.
我們在開發階段取得了顯著進展。

items.colloc: sign an agreement 簽署合約 | reach an agreement 達成協議
items.distinct: contract 合約 | settlement 協議（解決爭端）
ex: Both parties have finally reached a formal agreement.
雙方終於達成了一份正式協議。
Please read the agreement before you sign it.
在簽署之前，請詳閱這份合約。
We are in agreement regarding the project budget.
我們對專案預算達成了共識。

items.pos: n. 替代方案 | adj. 替代的
items.colloc: alternative solution 替代方案 | have no alternative 別無選擇
items.distinct: option 選項 | substitute 替代品
ex: We need to discuss an alternative solution today.
我們今天需要討論一個替代方案。
There is an alternative route to the office.
有一條通往辦公室的替代路線。
We have no alternative but to delay shipping.
我們別無選擇，只能延遲出貨。

items.colloc: professional appearance 專業形象 | make an appearance 出席
items.distinct: look 外表 | presence 出席
ex: A professional appearance is important for interviews.
專業的形象對面試很重要。
The CEO made a brief appearance at the party.
執行長在派對上短暫露面。
The product appearance was changed for the relaunch.
產品的外觀為了重新上市而做了改變。

items.colloc: arise from 起因於 | problems arise 問題產生
items.distinct: happen 發生 | emerge 顯現
ex: New problems may arise during the testing phase.
測試階段可能會出現新的問題。
Should any issues arise, please contact us immediately.
若有任何問題發生，請立即聯繫我們。
These complications arise from a lack of communication.
這些糾紛源於溝通不足。

items.colloc: every aspect 每個層面 | positive aspect 正面層面
items.distinct: facet 特徵 | view 觀點
ex: We need to consider every aspect of this deal.
我們需要考慮這筆交易的每一個層面。
The marketing aspect of the plan is strong.
這項計畫的行銷層面很強。
He studied the financial aspect of the company.
他研究了該公司的財務層面。

items.pos: n. 董事會；板子 | v. 登機/船
items.colloc: board of directors 董事會 | on board 在船上/機上
items.distinct: committee 委員會 | panel 專題小組
ex: The board of directors will meet tomorrow morning.
董事會將於明天早上開會。
Passengers can now board the plane at gate five.
旅客現在可以到五號登機門登機。
We wrote the new schedule on the whiteboard.
我們將新的行程表寫在白板上。

items.pos: n. 原因 | v. 導致
items.colloc: cause of the problem 問題原因 | cause damage 造成損害
items.distinct: reason 原因（說明理由） | trigger 觸發
ex: What is the primary cause of this delay?
這次延誤的主要原因是什麼？
Bad weather may cause a disruption in services.
惡劣天氣可能會導致服務中斷。
The new policy caused much discussion among staff.
新政策在員工間引起了許多討論。
